editorial_notes.note: Complete first curated pass of50 actual source units after the full859-unit Leviticus inventory. Original source references and anchors remain untouched. This is a cross-reference review and does not revise Scripture or claim exhaustive discovery.

Whole burnt offerings and sacrifices of deliverance remain distinct. Preserve male-only whole-offering eligibility beside male-or-female deliverance eligibility, singular hand beside plural hands, and different named participants and blood locations.

Retain turtledoves/pigeons, crop with feathers, east ash-place disposal, head-on-altar and draining-base wording. Poverty and childbirth alternatives retain their own bird numbers, conditions and purposes.

Preserve fine flour, oil, frankincense, oven/griddle/hearth preparations and memorial/remainder distinctions. The sin-flour gift excludes oil/frankincense; the priestly griddle gift is wholly burned and not eaten. No ordinary-remnant rule is imposed upon that priestly case.

Keep the prohibition of leaven/honey as altar offerings beside the permitted firstfruits presentation and the festival leavened loaves. Salt-covenant comparisons retain the separate priest-family and Davidic royal grants. Roasted/crushed groats are not renamed fine flour.

Retain belly fat, kidneys, liver lobe, unblemished loin and lower-back-muscle wording, as well as the different cattle/lamb/goat cases. Do not add a food-for-God formula absent from these Saints verses. Blood rationale retains the source claim that flesh's life is its blood, without new medical, original-language or specialist assertions.

editorial_notes.note: Preserve anointed-high-priest sin so that the people sin, the communal ignorance and knowledge clauses, ruler male goat, ordinary-person female goat and female sheep alternatives. No independent diagnosis or new original-language distinction is added to unintended/unknown wording.

The priest/congregation calf blood enters the tent with veil-side sprinkling and incense-altar horns before pouring at the offering-altar base. The ruler and individual goat/sheep cases name offering-altar horns and base. Leviticus16 and Hebrews9 retain their annual settings and other locations.

Deliverance-offering comparisons preserve the particular calf, goat and sheep fat/organ lists, including the supplied sheep loin/lower-back wording. Outside-camp burning and Hebrews13's later Jesus application remain distinct from the other sin-offering portions and priestly shares.

Witness silence, oath hearing, animal and human uncleanness, awareness, sworn words and confession remain separate stated conditions. Proverbs29:24's sentence continues in25; that full context was read. FirstJohn's confession language is labelled later instruction, not an identical offering rule.

Keep flock/bird/flour means-based alternatives, bird sin-first and whole-burnt-second sequence, distinct head and blood procedures, tenth of an oiphi, excluded oil/frankincense and the priestly remainder. Childbirth and Luke's bird-pair references keep their own occasion; no new household-income determination is made.

Holy-things wrong, general unknowing forbidden act and civil property false-dealing remain separate cases. Preserve valued unblemished rams, restitution plus a fifth, priest versus wronged-party recipients and original5:21-26 divisions. Exodus double-repayment and Numbers absence-of-kin provisions retain their different actors and conditions.

peer_review_receipts.read_scope: Read all50 actual source units in Leviticus1-3 during root's4-5 comparison, then reread all50 source units for independent QA. Read all99 rationale/relationship rows; an initial display truncated part of chapter3, so all34 chapter3 rows were displayed and reread separately. confirmed_distinctions: Opening speech from the tent is compared with the earlier tent-door disclosure and later Moses hearing the voice above the propitiatory cover, keeping their stated settings.

Animal classes, male versus male-or-female, unblemished eligibility, one hand versus hands, north-side slaughter, blood around altar versus around base, hide allocation and priestly participants retain each passage's wording.
Exodus29's ram washing and placing entrails/feet on pieces with head remain precise. Later Leviticus9 belly wording and Aaron's service are not substituted into the earlier entrails instruction.

Bird offerings retain the first sin-bird and second whole-offering distinction, nondivision, different head and blood actions, crop/feather eastward ash disposal and distinct childbirth and means-based provisions.

Fine flour, oil, frankincense, memorial handfuls, cooked forms, fragments, holy remnants and priest's wholly burned gifts remain distinct. Leviticus7's cooked-priest and oil/no-oil equal-share formulations are both retained without an invented uncooked-only clause.

Leaven/honey altar restrictions, firstfruits gifts to priests, sheaf and roasted-grain eating provisions, and groats versus flour are particular comparisons. Covenant-of-salt expressions retain sacrificial, priestly-portion and royal settings.
Deliverance-offering cattle, lamb and goat branches preserve the actual fat and organ lists, unblemished loin and lower-back-muscle language. No tail substitution is made.
Explicit sin-calf extraction comparisons, later deliverance service, guilt-ram portions and human fat/blood prohibitions retain separate offerings and contexts.

Same-chapter categories identify actual repeated procedures or adjacent clauses completing the introduced instruction. Later Ephesians offering/fragrance language remains a later application without claiming the bird procedure explicitly predicts Christ.
